Above all, our client is looking for a bright, proactive and commercially minded individual who enjoys taking ownership, is comfortable working autonomously and is keen to broaden their responsibilities. An interest in technology, Python or AI-driven process automation would be highly beneficial. Whilst there is flexibility, the role will likely cap out at around a £75k base salary. The company oversees a diverse portfolio of residential and commercial properties and emphasizes efficient operations, clear communication, and responsive service. AH Property Management values transparency, collaboration, and continuous improvement in all aspects of field and remote operations. Team members are encouraged to take initiative, solve problems, and contribute to streamlined processes. The company offers opportunities for professional development and advancement for individuals who are committed to operational excellence. Role Description The Field Operations Manager is a full-time remote role responsible for overseeing day-to-day property operations across a designated portfolio. This role coordinates and monitors maintenance activities, vendor work, inspections, and on-site services to ensure properties are well-maintained, safe, and compliant with relevant standards. The Field Operations Manager will assign and track work orders, review reports from field staff and contractors, and resolve operational issues promptly. This position regularly communicates with property owners, residents, and vendors to provide updates, address concerns, and maintain strong working relationships. The role also involves analyzing operational data, recommending process improvements, supporting budgeting and cost control efforts, and ensuring consistent implementation of company policies and procedures. Qualifications Strong field operations and property management capabilities, including coordination of maintenance, inspections, and vendor activities. Proficiency with scheduling, task tracking, and basic project management tools to oversee multiple properties and priorities remotely. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for collaborating with owners, residents, vendors, and internal teams. Ability to interpret operational data, identify trends, and recommend improvements to workflows and service delivery. Sound judgment and problem-solving skills for handling emergencies, resolving disputes, and making timely decisions. Comfort with technology, including property management software, collaboration platforms, and standard office applications. Experience in property management, facilities operations, or a related field; supervisory experience is a plus. Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage time effectively, and travel to properties as needed. Knowledge of basic building systems, safety standards, and relevant regulations is desirable. Associate or bachelor’s degree in business, property management, facilities management, or related discipline preferred, or equivalent practical experience. Fluency in English & Spanish. Pay: US $6- $7/hour depending on Experience Hours: Full Time / 9:00 AM Est - 5:00 PM Est

review_candidates.title: FSQA Manager
review_candidates.description: FSQA Manager Position Overview The FSQA (Food Safety & Quality Assurance) Manager will lead and oversee all food safety, quality assurance, and regulatory compliance activities across meat and protein processing operations. This role is responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining robust FSQA systems (HACCP, SSOP, GMPs), coordinating with USDA inspectors, driving continuous improvement in product safety and quality, and managing a team of quality professionals to ensure consistent, safe production of beef and other protein products through primary and further processing, including grinding operations. Key Responsibilities Develop, implement and maintain comprehensive food safety and quality programs (HACCP, SSOP, GMPs, prerequisite programs) tailored to meat, beef and protein manufacturing operations. Ensure compliance with federal and state regulations, including USDA/FSIS requirements; act as primary liaison with USDA inspectors and regulatory agencies. Lead and conduct internal audits, supplier audits and third-party audits; manage corrective actions and continuous improvement plans to address non-conformances. Oversee daily QA/QC activities on the plant floor, including monitoring critical control points, finished product testing, environmental and microbiological sampling, and verification of sanitation and allergen controls. Manage product release and hold procedures, lot traceability, recall readiness and execution, and crisis response related to food safety or quality incidents. Supervise, coach and develop a team of food safety and quality professionals; deliver training programs for production staff on food safety, GMPs, allergen control and proper grinding/further processing practices. Collaborate with operations, R&D, procurement and maintenance to drive quality improvements, optimize processing parameters (including grind specifications) and reduce rework and waste. Maintain accurate FSQA documentation, including records, specifications, SOPs and audit trails; ensure data integrity and effective use of LIMS/ERP quality modules. Analyze quality metrics and KPIs, prepare regular reports for senior leadership, and recommend strategic improvements to product quality, yield and safety. Qualifications Bachelors degree in Food Science, Animal Science, Microbiology or related field; advanced degree or relevant certifications (e.g., HACCP, PCQI, SQF Practitioner, CFS) preferred. 5+ years of progressive FSQA experience in meat, beef or protein manufacturing and processing, including working knowledge of further processing and grinding operations. Demonstrated knowledge of USDA/FSIS regulations, inspection processes and meat-processing compliance requirements. Strong experience developing and implementing HACCP plans, SSOPs, GMPs, CCP monitoring and environmental testing programs. Proven track record conducting internal, supplier and third-party audits; experience managing corrective actions and audit remediation. Familiarity with microbiological and chemical testing methodologies, LIMS, and quality data analysis; ability to interpret lab results and implement corrective strategies. Experience with food manufacturing systems, production floor supervision, and cross-functional collaboration in operations and procurement. Excellent leadership, communication and training skills; ability to influence at all levels and lead incident response and recall activities. Comfortable working in a regulated, fast-paced processing environment; willingness to work on-site and participate in plant production shifts as needed. review_candidates.title: F&B Associate
review_candidates.description: As an F&B Associate, you play a crucial role in ensuring exceptional guest experiences by providing efficient and friendly food and beverage service. Your responsibilities include taking orders, serving meals, and maintaining a clean and organized dining environment. You will collaborate with team members to deliver high-quality service and contribute to the overall success of the F&B operations. Key Job Responsibilities: Greet and welcome guests in a friendly and professional manner. Take customer orders, answer questions, and make menu recommendations. Relay orders to the kitchen and ensure accurate and timely delivery of food and beverages. Serve meals and drinks in accordance with established standards and presentation guidelines. Handle guest inquiries, concerns, and requests promptly and courteously. Maintain a clean and organized dining area, including setting up tables and clearing dishes. Collaborate with kitchen and the F&B team to ensure smooth coordination of service. Upsell menu items and promote special promotions to enhance the guest experience. Process customer payments and handle cash transactions accurately. Follow hygiene and safety guidelines to ensure a clean and safe working environment. Assist in restocking and replenishing supplies as needed. Work collaboratively with team members to achieve overall F&B goals and guest satisfaction. Uphold environmental, health, and safety standards in alignment with organizational policies. Adhere to the company’s environmental, health, and safety procedures and policies.
